items.title: 輝達將面臨更嚴格晶片出口管制 對中銷售「難上加難」
items.title_en: Nvidia Faces Tighter Chip Export Controls, Making Sales to China Even Harder
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 長期代表公司向華府爭取放寬對中 AI 晶片出口。如今，黃仁勳坦承婚外情，輝達董事會也展開獨立調查，釐清他是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定。
Moor Insights & Strategy 執行長 Patrick Moorhead 認為，這場風波已削弱黃仁勳在出口政策上的影響力，華府往後審查輝達的對中出口許可時，可能把這起事件納入考量。
美國國會兩黨議員正推動將三項晶片管制措施納入 2027 會計年度《國防授權法案》(NDAA)，最快可能在 12 月隨國防法案通過。
政策研究機構 Veda Partners 將其中《晶片安全法案》的成法機率從 60% 上調至 80%。華府關注的範圍也從輝達能否直接向中國出貨，延伸到晶片是否經第三國轉運，以及中國企業能否透過海外資料中心取得先進算力。
川普聲援黃仁勳 眾院三委員會要求閉門簡報
CNBC 報導，黃仁勳在川普第二任期曾就 AI 安全規範向白宮提供意見，也積極遊說放寬對中晶片銷售限制。Moorhead 表示，他在半導體業 35 年來，從未見過有晶片公司執行長對出口政策有如此直接的影響力。
黃仁勳一直是輝達與華府交涉中國業務的主要發言人，如今他能否維持這股影響力，將牽動輝達重返中國 AI 晶片市場的前景。
川普週一 (9 日) 在白宮表示，黃仁勳告訴他，當時並不知道對方涉嫌從事情報活動，川普也說他相信黃仁勳。黃仁勳在致員工信中承認對妻子不忠，未點名對象，並承諾全力配合調查。
輝達董事會表示，目前沒有理由認為美國國家安全或公司機密已遭損害，將由獨立董事與外部法律顧問檢視相關資訊。
眾院外交、情報及中國問題特別委員會的三名共和黨主席已要求黃仁勳於 11 月 18 日出席聯合閉門簡報，說明他與新加坡雲端算力業者 Megaspeed 前主管黃樂 (Alice Huang) 的往來，以及輝達防範外國間諜活動的措施。
眾院民主黨領袖傑佛瑞斯 (Hakeem Jeffries) 也要求國會取得完整簡報，並支持在國防法案最終版本納入對中晶片銷售限制。
三項法案分別鎖定晶片流向、出口許可與製造設備
三項措施已納入參議院的國防法案版本，眾議院版本則未納入。兩院協商的重點，是最終版本將保留哪些措施，以及管制範圍會有多大。Veda Partners 分析師 Henrietta Treyz 與 Dan McCarthy 上調了三案的成法機率。
《晶片安全法案》(Chip Security Act) 擬要求特定先進晶片及相關產品具備位置驗證功能。業者若掌握可信資訊，顯示產品所在地或使用者與出口許可不符，或安全機制遭到竄改，須向美國主管機關通報。成法機率由 60% 升至 80%。
《AI 監督法案》(AI Overwatch Act) 擬延長對中國等受關注國家出口最高階 AI 晶片的禁令。對於仍可申請許可的先進晶片，美國商務部核准前須向國會證明，出口不會排擠美國供應，也不會讓未獲授權的對象遠端使用。成法機率由 40% 升至 65%。
《多邊技術管制協調法案》(MATCH Act) 擬限制關鍵半導體設備銷往中國等受關注國家，並將維修與技術支援納入管制，同時推動盟友採取一致措施。成法機率由 35% 升至 60%。

共同推動《AI 監督法案》的民主黨參議員華倫 (Elizabeth Warren) 與共和黨參議員班克斯 (Jim Banks) 已呼籲將法案納入最終版本。Beacon Policy Advisors 資深研究分析師 Owen Tedford 則向《MarketWatch》表示，黃仁勳風波與白宮願意提出修訂建議，讓三案在國會更有推進動力。若兩院最終達成協議，他預期條文會較原案寬鬆，也更接近白宮主張。
Megaspeed 涉實體晶片流向 海外租用算力另成審查焦點
《紐約時報》報導，美方情報人員認為，黃樂涉嫌為北京蒐集資訊。中國外交部否認相關指控。
美方另在調查 Megaspeed 是否將受管制的輝達晶片轉運至中國。
輝達法務長曾致信美國商務部詢問調查情況，案件其後移交司法部。Megaspeed 否認違法，表示先前檢查未發現違規證據。
《彭博》比對貿易紀錄後發現，Megaspeed 進口的輝達晶片，比輝達最初在其資料中心盤點的數量多出約 5 萬顆。
輝達其後表示，已在其他倉庫找到相關硬體，未公布具體數量。
Moorhead 指出，Blackwell 晶片是否曾經由 Megaspeed 流入中國，早在這次風波前就已是華府關注的問題。

華府也在檢視另一條路徑。中國企業可向海外業者租用伺服器算力，實體晶片仍留在當地。CNBC 此前報導，中國 AI 新創月之暗面 (Moonshot AI) 曾洽談在歐洲租用至少 8,000 顆 Blackwell GPU 組成的叢集，主要用於 AI 推論，目前尚無成交消息。Veda 分析師認為，川普政府短期內最可能先加強查緝晶片走私，限制中國企業遠端使用海外算力的可能性較低，近期撤銷輝達 H200 對中出口許可的機率也偏低。
H200 對中出貨仍有限 第三季財測已排除中國資料中心運算營收
美國自 2022 年收緊先進晶片出口管制後，輝達多次為中國市場調整產品規格。
2025 年 4 月，川普政府將輝達為因應管制而推出的 H20 納入出口許可要求。輝達最初估計庫存與採購承諾相關費用最高約 55 億美元，最後實際認列 45 億美元。
美國商務部今年 1 月改為逐案審查 H200 等晶片的對中出口申請，並自 2 月起核發部分許可。
黃仁勳 3 月表示，輝達已接獲中國客戶訂單，並著手重啟生產。但輝達在財報中指出，受北京方面限制，實際出貨僅占美方核准數量的一小部分。
截至 7 月 26 日的一季，依許可出貨至中國的 H200 所帶來的營收，占輝達全球資料中心營收不到 1%。
按直接客戶總部所在地統計，輝達 2026 會計年度來自中國 (含香港) 的營收為 196.77 億美元，占總營收 9.1%。截至今年 7 月 26 日的一季則為 78.80 億美元，占 8.2%。這項區域營收涵蓋遊戲、車用等業務，客戶總部所在地也可能與晶片出貨地或終端使用地不同。
輝達對 2027 會計年度第三季開出的 1,080 億美元營收指引，已將中國資料中心運算營收按零估算。
因此，H200 許可若進一步收緊，首先影響的是輝達未來擴大對中出貨的空間。若國會或白宮進一步管制海外晶片流向與遠端算力，影響範圍則可能延伸到輝達的海外雲端客戶。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 連兩個交易日收黑，美東時間週一 (9 日) 收跌 4.27%，報 178.67 美元，市值縮水約 1,921 億美元。週二 (10 日) 再跌 5.53%，收在 168.80 美元，市值再減約 2,379 億美元。兩日股價累計下跌 9.56%，市值合計蒸發約 4,300 億美元，降至約 4.07 兆美元。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has long represented the company in lobbying Washington for relaxed AI chip export restrictions to China. Now Huang admits to an extramarital affair, and Nvidia's board has launched an independent investigation to determine whether he was ever targeted by foreign intelligence operations.

Patrick Moorhead, CEO of Moor Insights & Strategy, says the scandal has weakened Huang's influence on export policy, and future U.S. reviews of Nvidia's China‑export licenses may take this incident into account.

Bipartisan members of Congress are pushing to incorporate three chip‑control measures into the FY2027 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), which could pass as part of the defense bill as early as December.

Policy research firm Veda Partners raised the likelihood of the Chip Security Act becoming law from 60% to 80%. The scope of Washington's concern now extends beyond whether Nvidia can ship directly to China to include third‑country transshipment and whether Chinese firms can obtain advanced compute via overseas data centers.
Trump backs Huang; House three‑committee panel demands a closed‑door briefing

CNBC reports that Huang, during Trump’s second term, advised the White House on AI safety standards and actively lobbied to ease chip‑sale restrictions to China. Moorhead says in his 35‑year semiconductor career he has never seen a chip‑company CEO wield such direct influence over export policy.

Huang has been Nvidia’s primary spokesperson in dealings with Washington over its China business, and his ability to retain that influence will affect Nvidia’s prospects of re‑entering the Chinese AI‑chip market.

On Monday (the 9th), Trump told the White House that Huang said he was unaware of any intelligence‑gathering activities and that Trump believes him. Huang’s employee letter admitted infidelity without naming the other party and pledged full cooperation with the investigation.

Nvidia’s board said there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or company secrets have been compromised; independent directors and external legal counsel will review the relevant information.

Three Republican chairs of the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China committees have asked Huang to appear at a joint closed‑door briefing on November 18 to explain his contacts with former Megaspeed cloud‑computing executive Alice Huang and Nvidia’s anti‑espionage safeguards.
House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries also wants Congress to receive the full briefing and supports adding China‑chip‑sale restrictions to the final defense bill.
The three bills each target chip flow, export licensing, and manufacturing equipment

The three measures have been included in the Senate version of the defense bill, but not in the House version. Negotiations will focus on which provisions survive in the final bill and how broad the controls will be. Veda Partners analysts Henrietta Treyz and Dan McCarthy have raised the passage odds for all three.

The Chip Security Act would require certain advanced chips and related products to have location‑verification capabilities. If a holder detects that a product’s location or user does not match its export license, or that security mechanisms have been tampered with, they must report it to U.S. authorities. Passage odds rise from 60% to 80%.

The AI Overwatch Act would extend the ban on exporting top‑tier AI chips to China and other scrutinized nations. For advanced chips still eligible for a license, the Commerce Department must first certify to Congress that the export will not displace U.S. supply nor enable unauthorized remote use. Passage odds rise from 40% to 65%.

The MATCH Act would restrict sales of key semiconductor equipment to China and other targeted countries, bring repair and technical support under control, and push allies to adopt coordinated measures. Passage odds rise from 35% to 60%.

Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren and Republican Senator Jim Banks, co‑sponsors of the AI Overwatch Act, have urged its inclusion in the final bill. Owen Tedford, senior analyst at Beacon Policy Advisors, told MarketWatch that the Huang scandal and the White House’s willingness to propose revisions give the three bills more momentum in Congress. If the two chambers reach an agreement, he expects the final language to be softer than the original drafts and closer to the White House’s position.
Megaspeed’s involvement in physical chip flow and overseas compute rentals becomes another focus of scrutiny
The New York Times reported that U.S. intelligence believes Alice Huang is suspected of gathering information for Beijing. China’s foreign ministry denied the allegations.
U.S. investigators are also looking into whether Megaspeed routed controlled Nvidia chips to China.

Nvidia’s general counsel previously wrote to the Commerce Department asking about the investigation; the matter was later handed to the Justice Department. Megaspeed denies any wrongdoing, saying earlier checks found no evidence of violations.
Bloomberg’s trade‑record analysis found that Megaspeed imported about 50,000 more Nvidia chips than the inventory Nvidia initially recorded in its data centers.
Nvidia later said it found the hardware in other warehouses but did not disclose the exact quantity.
Moorhead noted that whether Blackwell chips ever passed through Megaspeed into China was a concern in Washington even before this scandal.

Washington is also examining another route. Chinese firms can rent server capacity from overseas providers while the physical chips remain abroad. CNBC previously reported that Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI had discussed renting a cluster of at least 8,000 Blackwell GPUs in Europe for inference workloads, though no deal has been confirmed. Veda analysts think the Trump administration is more likely in the short term to crack down on chip smuggling than to restrict Chinese firms’ remote use of overseas compute, and they see a low probability of revoking Nvidia’s H200 China export license soon.
H200 shipments to China remain limited; Q3 forecasts have already excluded revenue from Chinese data‑center compute
Since the U.S. tightened advanced‑chip export controls in 2022, Nvidia has repeatedly adjusted product specifications for the Chinese market.

In April 2025, the Trump administration added Nvidia’s H20, launched to meet the controls, to its export‑license requirements. Nvidia initially estimated up to $5.5 billion in inventory and procurement costs, ultimately recognizing $4.5 billion.
The Commerce Department switched to case‑by‑case reviews of H200 and similar chips’ China export applications in January and began issuing partial licenses in February.

In March, Huang said Nvidia had received orders from Chinese customers and was restarting production, but the company noted that, due to Beijing’s restrictions, actual shipments were only a small fraction of the approved volume.
For the quarter ending July 26, H200 shipments authorized for China accounted for less than 1% of Nvidia’s global data‑center revenue.

Based on the headquarters location of direct customers, Nvidia’s FY2026 revenue from China (including Hong Kong) was $19.677 billion, or 9.1% of total revenue; for the quarter ending July 26 it was $7.88 billion, or 8.2%. This regional figure includes gaming, automotive and other businesses, and the customer’s headquarters may not match the chip’s shipment or end‑use location.
Nvidia’s FY2027 Q3 revenue guidance of $108 billion assumes zero revenue from Chinese data‑center compute.

Thus, any further tightening of H200 licenses would first curb Nvidia’s ability to expand shipments to China. If Congress or the White House adds controls on overseas chip flow or remote compute, the impact could extend to Nvidia’s foreign cloud customers.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) fell black for two consecutive trading days. On Monday (the 9th) Eastern Time it dropped 4.27% to $178.67, wiping about $192.1 billion off its market cap. On Tuesday (the 10th) it fell another 5.53% to $168.80, shaving roughly $237.9 billion more. The two‑day decline totalled 9.56%, erasing about $430 billion in market value and leaving the company worth roughly $4.07 trillion.

items.title: CoreWeave股價自高點跌掉65%還沒脫困 財報亮眼也難解三大隱憂
items.title_en: CoreWeave Stock Down 65% From Peak Still Not Rescued; Strong Earnings Can't Allay Three Major Concerns
paras: AI新興雲端業者CoreWeave, Inc. Class A(CRWV-US) 第三季營收年增168%、上修全年財測，帶動周二（10日）盤後股價走高。但該股自半年前高點已重挫65%，亮眼財報仍難消除市場疑慮，資料中心建設受阻、科技巨頭支出收緊與債務壓力，持續籠罩成長前景。
營收大增168% 全年財測上修
根據公司聲明，CoreWeave第三季營收年增168%，但淨損也由去年同期的1.1億美元擴大至7.09億美元，相當於每股虧損1.27美元。季末未完成訂單達1,325億美元，這項衡量未來銷售情況的指標受到市場密切關注。
管理層將2026年全年營收預估上修至130億至133億美元，高於8月預估的124億至132億美元；調整後營業利益預估則由9.6億至11.5億美元，提高至12.75億至13.75億美元。
儘管營收成長與財測上修顯示AI基礎建設需求仍強，市場焦點已轉向成長能否持續。CoreWeave上周股價重挫15%，財報公布前的選擇權市場資料顯示，投資人預期財報後股價波動幅度約達16%。
選後建設阻力升高 新興雲端股承壓
美國期中選舉結果，成為衝擊市場情緒的直接導火線。多地選民表態反對在社區附近興建資料中心，使對AI基礎建設較為保守的民主黨籍州級與地方政府影響力上升，也讓投資人更關注管理層如何因應建設環境變化。
以德州為例，候任州長Gina Hinojosa已公開呼籲立即暫停資料中心專案審批。CoreWeave隨即致函，表達尋求合作的意願。
選後科技股走勢明顯分歧。微軟(MSFT-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 等大型雲端業者股價反彈，CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Nebius (YNDX-US) 及Iris (IREN-US) 等新興雲端業者則大幅下挫。
對大型雲端業者而言，AI資本支出放緩可能改善自由現金流；但對依賴AI高速成長支撐商業模式的新興業者來說，支出與建設減速，將直接衝擊核心業務。
50 Park Investments執行長Adam Sarhan表示，美國選民已透過選票表明，不希望資料中心建在住家附近。
新興雲端業者的處境因此更加艱難，因為它們缺乏其他收入來源，難以彌補AI業務可能出現的損失。
靠借貸擴張 部分債券殖利率突破15%
CoreWeave透過舉債興建資料中心，必須維持高速成長，才能支應債務成本。這種財務結構，使公司在建設與支出前景轉趨不明之際格外脆弱。
選舉結束後，CoreWeave債券價格隨即下跌，部分債券殖利率突破15%，進入市場通常視為困境債務的區間。
根據彭博彙整的分析師預估，CoreWeave在2029年以前仍將持續虧損，未來幾年的營收增速也將逐年放緩。第三季實際淨損大幅擴大，更凸顯營收快速成長之際，公司仍承受虧損壓力。
目前CoreWeave股價營收比約為1倍，接近歷史低點，僅約2025年3月上市以來平均水準的四分之一。然而，由於公司持續虧損，按多數估值指標衡量，股價仍顯昂貴。
Founder ETFs投資組合經理Michael Monaghan指出，AI支出前景的重要性遠超過財報本身，市場擔心的是，期中選舉是否意味AI基礎建設將進入減速週期。
財報難解疑慮 AI投資回報成關鍵
客戶的支出動向，也增添CoreWeave面臨的不確定性。微軟正加強部分專案的監督，並退出其認為風險過高的計畫。
CoreWeave的困境，也是本輪AI財報季市場情緒承壓的縮影。谷歌、Meta、亞馬遜與英特爾(INTC-US) 相繼遭遇財報後賣壓，微軟與SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 的強勁業績，同樣未能阻止股價下跌。
投資人對AI投資回報的質疑持續升高。在尚未看到更明確回報的情況下，市場對科技公司龐大AI資本支出的可持續性愈來愈審慎。
Sarhan表示，若AI收入枯竭，這些公司的合理價值幾乎肯定低於目前股價。除了AI之外，成長動能從何而來，以及若無法靠成長償還債務，如何維持償債能力，都是核心問題。
他也承認，新興雲端股短線技術面已出現超賣跡象，但在高度不確定性下，很難想像它們能重返過去的估值水準。
paras_en: AI‑focused cloud provider CoreWeave, Inc. Class A (CRWV‑US) reported third‑quarter revenue up 168% year‑over‑year and raised its full‑year outlook, sending the after‑hours price higher on Tuesday (the 10th). Yet the shares have fallen 65% from their six‑month high, and the impressive results have not erased market worries about data‑center construction delays, tighter spending by tech giants and debt pressure, all of which continue to cloud its growth outlook.
Revenue jumps 168% and full‑year outlook raised

According to the company’s statement, CoreWeave’s Q3 revenue grew 168% year‑over‑year, but net loss also widened from $110 million a year ago to $709 million, or a loss of $1.27 per share. Back‑log at quarter‑end stood at $132.5 billion, a metric that investors watch closely as an indicator of future sales.

Management lifted its 2026 full‑year revenue forecast to $13.0‑$13.3 billion, above the August range of $12.4‑$13.2 billion; adjusted operating profit guidance was also raised from $960 million‑$1.15 billion to $1.275‑$1.375 billion.

Although the revenue growth and upgraded outlook show that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong, the market’s focus has shifted to whether that growth can be sustained. CoreWeave’s stock fell 15% last week, and options data before the earnings release indicated investors expect post‑earnings price swings of roughly 16%.
Post‑election construction headwinds increase pressure on emerging cloud stocks

The U.S. midterm election results became a direct catalyst for market sentiment. Voters in many areas voiced opposition to building data centers near residential neighborhoods, boosting the influence of Democratic state‑ and local‑government officials who are more cautious about AI infrastructure and prompting investors to watch how management will respond to the changing construction environment.

In Texas, for example, gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa has publicly called for an immediate pause on data‑center project approvals. CoreWeave promptly sent a letter expressing its willingness to cooperate.

Post‑election tech‑stock performance diverged sharply. Shares of large cloud players such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) rebounded, while emerging cloud firms like CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Nebius (YNDX‑US) and Iris (IREN‑US) slumped sharply.

For the big cloud providers, a slowdown in AI capital spending could improve free cash flow; for emerging players that rely on rapid AI‑driven growth to sustain their business models, slower spending and construction directly hits their core operations.
50 Park Investments CEO Adam Sarhan said U.S. voters have signaled through the ballot that they do not want data centers built near homes.
The situation for emerging cloud firms therefore becomes tougher, because they lack other revenue streams to offset potential losses from their AI businesses.
Expansion funded by debt; some bond yields break 15%

CoreWeave finances data‑center builds through borrowing and must keep growth fast enough to cover debt costs. This capital structure makes the company especially vulnerable when construction and spending outlooks become uncertain.
After the election, CoreWeave bond prices fell sharply, with yields on some issues pushing past 15%, a level typically viewed as distressed debt territory.

Bloomberg‑aggregated analyst estimates suggest CoreWeave will remain loss‑making until at least 2029, with revenue growth slowing year over year in the coming years. The sharply larger Q3 net loss underscores that, despite rapid revenue expansion, the company is still under loss pressure.

CoreWeave’s price‑to‑revenue multiple is now about 1×, near a historic low and roughly a quarter of its average level since its March 2025 IPO. Yet because the firm continues to lose money, most valuation metrics still deem the stock expensive.

Founder ETFs portfolio manager Michael Monaghan noted that the importance of AI‑spending outlook far outweighs the earnings numbers themselves; the market worries whether the midterms signal the start of a slowdown in AI infrastructure investment.
Earnings can’t dispel concerns; AI investment returns become the key issue
Customer spending trends also add to CoreWeave’s uncertainty. Microsoft is tightening oversight on certain projects and pulling out of programs it deems too risky.

CoreWeave’s predicament mirrors the broader pressure on AI‑earnings season sentiment. Google, Meta, Amazon and Intel (INTC‑US) all faced selling pressure after their reports, and even strong results from Microsoft and SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) failed to stop their shares from falling.

Investor doubts about AI‑investment returns are rising. Without clearer evidence of payoff, the market is becoming increasingly cautious about the sustainability of massive AI capital outlays by tech firms.

Sarhan said that if AI revenue dries up, the fair value of these companies would almost certainly be below current stock prices. Beyond AI, the question is where growth will come from and, if growth can’t service debt, how they will maintain solvency.

He also acknowledged that emerging‑cloud stocks have shown short‑term technical oversold signals, but in an environment of high uncertainty it is hard to imagine they can regain their previous valuation levels.

items.title: Fed鮑曼示警：AI投資回報若不如預期 美股估值恐大幅修正
items.title_en: Fed Bowman Warns: AI Investment Returns Could Trigger Major US Stock Valuation Adjustments
paras: 聯準會(Fed)理事鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)表示，金融市場可能對經濟活動帶來多項風險，例如人工智慧(AI)投資報酬若不如預期，可能引發股價大幅下跌。
鮑曼周二(10日)在外交關係協會(Council on Foreign Relations)發表演說，點出AI投資報酬不如預期可能導致「股市估值大幅修正」，以及「私人長期利率急遽上升」的風險。
她說：「股價下跌可能削弱消費支出的韌性。利率上升則可能進一步加重經濟中對利率敏感產業的壓力，例如住宅市場與小型企業投資。」
鮑曼也暗示，在通膨持續居高不下之際，她可能支持Fed在下個月的今年最後一次會議升息。她說：「目前我看到通膨壓力持續存在的跡象，勞動市場狀況似乎也正在轉強。這顯示我們仍有工作要做，才能讓通膨率更接近2%的目標。」
Fed官員9月啟動三年來首次升息之後，在10月27-28日的會議上決定維持利率不變。美國通膨已連續超過五年高於2%目標。
鮑曼表示，她支持上個月維持利率不變的決定，目的是讓Fed有更多時間了解經濟情勢如何演變，以及9月升息將如何影響經濟基本趨勢。不過她認為，近期通膨數據比她原先預期更為火熱。
鮑曼說：「雖然我仍預期目前推升通膨的幾項因素將在明年消退，但目前通膨的持續時間已超出我的預期。」
根據Fed官員9月公布的利率預測中位數，多數官員當時認為今年至少還需要升息一次。近期多名聯準會官員重申這項看法，並表示升息可以循序漸進。
Fed另一名理事華勒(Christopher Waller)似乎更積極，他周二稍早表示應考慮在12月會議升息2碼(0.5百分點)。
華勒發表談話後不久，美國勞工部公布10月消費者物價指數(CPI)漲幅高於預期，核心通膨月增0.3%，達到華勒先前所說可能促使Fed採取更大幅度升息的門檻。
同日發表談話的達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)則表示，她仍認為至少需要再升息2次、每次1碼(25個基點)，但並未表態支持一次升息2碼。
今年有投票權的蘿根在休士頓一場會議的事先準備講稿中說：「根據目前的經濟展望，我仍清楚認為，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)至少需要再實施2次、每次25個基點的升息。」

AI建設融資快速擴張 相關債務今年恐逾8000億美元

鮑曼在演講中也對快速增加的AI相關債務表達疑慮。由於企業債券、私人信貸及專案融資規模都明顯成長，相關融資金額今年可能超過8000億美元。
她表示：「由於信用評等良好，超大規模雲端業者(hyperscalers)及大型科技公司承擔表外負債，讓規模較小、風險較高的企業能以這些負債作為擔保，透過資產融資的方式為資料中心建設及採購加速運算設備籌資。」
鮑曼指出，AI企業之間彼此連結，超大規模雲端業者及晶片設計商回過頭來對購買其產品的小型企業進行股權投資，形成循環融資的表象。
paras_en: Fed Governor Michelle Bowman said financial markets could pose multiple risks to economic activity, such as AI investment returns falling short of expectations, potentially causing a sharp decline in stock prices.

On Tuesday (10th), Bowman spoke at the Council on Foreign Relations, pointing out that AI investment returns falling short of expectations could lead to a "large correction in stock market valuations" and a "rapid rise in private long‑term rates."

She said, "A decline in stock prices could weaken the resilience of consumer spending. Rising rates could further increase pressure on rate‑sensitive sectors of the economy, such as the housing market and small‑business investment."

Bowman also hinted that, amid persistently high inflation, she might support a Fed rate hike at the last meeting of the year next month. She said, "I currently see signs of ongoing inflationary pressure, and the labor market appears to be strengthening. This shows we still have work to do to bring inflation closer to the 2% target."

After the Fed's first rate hike in three years in September, the Fed left rates unchanged at the meeting on October 27‑28. U.S. inflation has been above the 2% target for more than five consecutive years.

Bowman said she supports the decision to keep rates unchanged last month, aiming to give the Fed more time to understand how economic conditions evolve and how the September hike will affect economic fundamentals. However, she believes recent inflation data are hotter than she originally expected.
Bowman said, "Although I still expect the factors driving inflation to subside next year, the duration of inflation has exceeded my expectations."

According to the median rate forecast released by Fed officials in September, most officials then believed at least one more hike was needed this year. Several Fed officials recently reiterated this view, stating that hikes could be gradual.
Another Fed governor, Christopher Waller, seemed more aggressive, saying earlier on Tuesday that a 2‑basis‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) hike should be considered at the December meeting.

Shortly after Waller's remarks, the U.S. Department of Labor released October CPI data that rose above expectations, with core inflation up 0.3% month‑on‑month, reaching the threshold Waller had said could prompt a larger Fed hike.
On the same day, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said she still believes at least two more hikes of 1 basis point each are needed, but did not endorse a single 2‑basis‑point hike.

Logan, who has voting rights this year, said in a pre‑meeting briefing in Houston, "Based on the current economic outlook, I still clearly believe the FOMC needs to implement at least two more 25‑basis‑point hikes."

Bowman also expressed concern about the rapid expansion of AI‑related debt. Because corporate bonds, private credit, and project financing have all grown significantly, the amount of financing this year could exceed $800 billion.

She said, "Because of strong credit ratings, hyperscalers and large tech firms are taking on off‑balance‑sheet liabilities, allowing smaller, riskier firms to use these liabilities as collateral to finance data‑center construction and accelerate the procurement of high‑performance computing equipment."

Bowman pointed out that AI firms are interconnected, with hyperscalers and chip designers turning back to invest in equity of the small firms that purchase their products, creating a cycle of financing that appears circular.

items.title: OpenAI第三季營收首破100億美元！季增近50%、年增近3倍
items.title_en: OpenAI’s Q3 Revenue Breaks $10 Billion for the First Time – Up Nearly 50% QoQ and Almost 3‑Fold YoY
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司OpenAI營運動能持續增強，第三季營收首度突破100億美元，受惠於市場對其最新AI軟體需求強勁，營收較前一季成長近50%，較去年同期接近成長至原來的3倍。
根據《彭博》引述知情人士報導，OpenAI截至9月底的三個月營收首度達到100億美元。相關財務數據於周二（10日）向投資人說明會中披露。OpenAI拒絕對此置評。
OpenAI今年一度在部分營運指標上落後長期競爭對手Anthropic，但近期透過推出具競爭力的新AI模型、大幅調降產品價格，以及加強布局AI代理（AI Agents），協助客戶將工作流程自動化，重新取得市場動能。
相較之下，Anthropic的營收成長速度近期略有放緩。該公司第三季營收約170億美元，較第二季成長約47%，遠低於前一季超過140%的增幅。
不過，OpenAI與Anthropic在計算營收資料時所採用的方法歷來都有所不同。
資本市場布局方面，OpenAI目前正推進新一輪募資，目標估值達1.25兆美元，並已將原定上市計畫延後至明年。
根據《彭博》先前報導，OpenAI近期已完成這輪募資中的首批110億美元資金。
Anthropic則計畫於本月稍晚上市，目標估值為1.4兆美元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Artificial‑intelligence startup OpenAI is seeing its operating momentum continue to strengthen, with Q3 revenue surpassing $10 billion for the first time. Driven by strong market demand for its latest AI software, revenue grew by almost 50% from the previous quarter and approached three times the level of the same period last year.

According to Bloomberg, citing sources familiar with the matter, OpenAI’s revenue for the three months ending September 30 hit $10 billion for the first time. The financial figures were disclosed at an investor briefing on Tuesday (the 10th). OpenAI declined to comment.

Earlier this year OpenAI lagged behind long‑time rival Anthropic on several operating metrics, but it has recently regained market momentum by launching competitive new AI models, sharply cutting product prices, and expanding its AI‑Agents offering to help customers automate workflows.

By contrast, Anthropic’s revenue growth has slowed slightly. The company posted Q3 revenue of about $17 billion, up roughly 47% from Q2, far below the more than 140% jump it recorded in the prior quarter.
However, OpenAI and Anthropic have historically used different methodologies when calculating revenue figures.
On the capital‑markets side, OpenAI is currently pursuing a new funding round targeting a $1.25 trillion valuation and has postponed its planned IPO until next year.
Bloomberg previously reported that OpenAI has already secured the first tranche of $11 billion in this funding round.
Anthropic, on the other hand, plans to go public later this month, targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: CoreWeave上修財測、訂單突破1,300億美元但龐大資本支出仍考驗資金能力
items.title_en: CoreWeave Raises Revenue Forecast, Orders Top $130 Billion but Massive Capex Still Tests Funding Capacity
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)11月10日上修全年營收展望，已簽約的未來營收突破1,300億美元，反映AI算力需求持續增加。不過，訂單快速成長也讓公司必須投入更多資金擴建資料中心，全年資本支出預估高達390億美元。在借款成本偏高、總債務接近470億美元的情況下，市場關注的焦點已不只是訂單能增加多少，而是公司能否順利籌措建設資金，並將訂單轉為實際收入。
CoreWeave第三季營收36.6億美元，年增近170%，高於市場預估的35.5億美元；每股虧損0.95美元，也優於預期的虧損1.16美元。公司將2026年營收預估由124億至132億美元，上調至130億至133億美元。另一方面，截至9月底，已簽約但尚未認列的營收由6月底的1,040億美元增加至1,325億美元，短短一季增加285億美元，顯示客戶對未來AI算力的採購仍在擴大。
隨著訂單增加，CoreWeave也加快資料中心建設。第三季資本支出由前一季94億美元增加至145億美元，公司並將全年資本支出下限提高20億美元，最新預估為370億至390億美元。由於資料中心必須先完成建設、採購GPU等設備，才能開始向客戶提供算力服務，因此龐大的投資支出往往早於營收回收，讓資金調度成為擴張過程中的主要挑戰。
面對市場對借款負擔的疑慮，CoreWeave強調，公司採取先取得客戶合約、再投入資料中心建設的模式，而非先建置大量算力再尋找客戶。執行長Mike Intrator表示，客戶通常也會協助支付部分建置成本。公司預計未來三個月可收到90億美元的客戶預付款與保證金，作為後續建設的資金來源。

paras_en: On Tuesday, November 10, U.S. equities closed lower. October inflation came in above market expectations, and Federal Reserve officials signaled possible rate hikes, pushing Treasury yields higher and weighing on the market. Technology stocks led the declines, with Nvidia (NVDA-US) weakening for the second consecutive session, and the Nasdaq index giving back part of its 2.7% surge from Monday.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 158 points to close at 52,232, down 0.30%; the S&P 500 slipped 29 points to 7,521, down 0.38%; and the Nasdaq dropped 187 points to 25,066, down 0.74%. S&P 500 technology stocks fell more than 1%, making them the weakest among the eleven major sectors, with Nvidia down nearly 6% and about a 10% decline over two trading days.

Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said before the data release that if core CPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, he would consider a two‑basis‑point rate hike at the Dec. 8‑9 meeting. Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan also noted that at least two additional one‑basis‑point hikes would be needed. The inflation data and officials’ comments led investors to reassess rate outlooks, sending the two‑year Treasury yield up about 18 basis points to 4.731%—the biggest single‑day rise since April 2025—and pushing the ten‑year yield to 4.988%.

items.title: 輝達將面臨更嚴格晶片出口管制 對中銷售「難上加難」

paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 長期代表公司向華府爭取放寬對中 AI 晶片出口。如今，黃仁勳坦承婚外情，輝達董事會也展開獨立調查，釐清他是否曾遭外國情報行動鎖定。
Moor Insights & Strategy 執行長 Patrick Moorhead 認為，這場風波已削弱黃仁勳在出口政策上的影響力，華府往後審查輝達的對中出口許可時，可能把這起事件納入考量。
美國國會兩黨議員正推動將三項晶片管制措施納入 2027 會計年度《國防授權法案》(NDAA)，最快可能在 12 月隨國防法案通過。
政策研究機構 Veda Partners 將其中《晶片安全法案》的成法機率從 60% 上調至 80%。華府關注的範圍也從輝達能否直接向中國出貨，延伸到晶片是否經第三國轉運，以及中國企業能否透過海外資料中心取得先進算力。
川普聲援黃仁勳 眾院三委員會要求閉門簡報
CNBC 報導，黃仁勳在川普第二任期曾就 AI 安全規範向白宮提供意見，也積極遊說放寬對中晶片銷售限制。Moorhead 表示，他在半導體業 35 年來，從未見過有晶片公司執行長對出口政策有如此直接的影響力。
黃仁勳一直是輝達與華府交涉中國業務的主要發言人，如今他能否維持這股影響力，將牽動輝達重返中國 AI 晶片市場的前景。
川普週一 (9 日) 在白宮表示，黃仁勳告訴他，當時並不知道對方涉嫌從事情報活動，川普也說他相信黃仁勳。黃仁勳在致員工信中承認對妻子不忠，未點名對象，並承諾全力配合調查。
輝達董事會表示，目前沒有理由認為美國國家安全或公司機密已遭損害，將由獨立董事與外部法律顧問檢視相關資訊。
眾院外交、情報及中國問題特別委員會的三名共和黨主席已要求黃仁勳於 11 月 18 日出席聯合閉門簡報，說明他與新加坡雲端算力業者 Megaspeed 前主管黃樂 (Alice Huang) 的往來，以及輝達防範外國間諜活動的措施。
眾院民主黨領袖傑佛瑞斯 (Hakeem Jeffries) 也要求國會取得完整簡報，並支持在國防法案最終版本納入對中晶片銷售限制。
三項法案分別鎖定晶片流向、出口許可與製造設備
三項措施已納入參議院的國防法案版本，眾議院版本則未納入。兩院協商的重點，是最終版本將保留哪些措施，以及管制範圍會有多大。Veda Partners 分析師 Henrietta Treyz 與 Dan McCarthy 上調了三案的成法機率。
《晶片安全法案》(Chip Security Act) 擬要求特定先進晶片及相關產品具備位置驗證功能。業者若掌握可信資訊，顯示產品所在地或使用者與出口許可不符，或安全機制遭到竄改，須向美國主管機關通報。成法機率由 60% 升至 80%。
《AI 監督法案》(AI Overwatch Act) 擬延長對中國等受關注國家出口最高階 AI 晶片的禁令。對於仍可申請許可的先進晶片，美國商務部核准前須向國會證明，出口不會排擠美國供應，也不會讓未獲授權的對象遠端使用。成法機率由 40% 升至 65%。
《多邊技術管制協調法案》(MATCH Act) 擬限制關鍵半導體設備銷往中國等受關注國家，並將維修與技術支援納入管制，同時推動盟友採取一致措施。成法機率由 35% 升至 60%。

共同推動《AI 監督法案》的民主黨參議員華倫 (Elizabeth Warren) 與共和黨參議員班克斯 (Jim Banks) 已呼籲將法案納入最終版本。Beacon Policy Advisors 資深研究分析師 Owen Tedford 則向《MarketWatch》表示，黃仁勳風波與白宮願意提出修訂建議，讓三案在國會更有推進動力。若兩院最終達成協議，他預期條文會較原案寬鬆，也更接近白宮主張。
Megaspeed 涉實體晶片流向 海外租用算力另成審查焦點
《紐約時報》報導，美方情報人員認為，黃樂涉嫌為北京蒐集資訊。中國外交部否認相關指控。
美方另在調查 Megaspeed 是否將受管制的輝達晶片轉運至中國。
輝達法務長曾致信美國商務部詢問調查情況，案件其後移交司法部。Megaspeed 否認違法，表示先前檢查未發現違規證據。
《彭博》比對貿易紀錄後發現，Megaspeed 進口的輝達晶片，比輝達最初在其資料中心盤點的數量多出約 5 萬顆。
輝達其後表示，已在其他倉庫找到相關硬體，未公布具體數量。
Moorhead 指出，Blackwell 晶片是否曾經由 Megaspeed 流入中國，早在這次風波前就已是華府關注的問題。

華府也在檢視另一條路徑。中國企業可向海外業者租用伺服器算力，實體晶片仍留在當地。CNBC 此前報導，中國 AI 新創月之暗面 (Moonshot AI) 曾洽談在歐洲租用至少 8,000 顆 Blackwell GPU 組成的叢集，主要用於 AI 推論，目前尚無成交消息。Veda 分析師認為，川普政府短期內最可能先加強查緝晶片走私，限制中國企業遠端使用海外算力的可能性較低，近期撤銷輝達 H200 對中出口許可的機率也偏低。
H200 對中出貨仍有限 第三季財測已排除中國資料中心運算營收
美國自 2022 年收緊先進晶片出口管制後，輝達多次為中國市場調整產品規格。
2025 年 4 月，川普政府將輝達為因應管制而推出的 H20 納入出口許可要求。輝達最初估計庫存與採購承諾相關費用最高約 55 億美元，最後實際認列 45 億美元。
美國商務部今年 1 月改為逐案審查 H200 等晶片的對中出口申請，並自 2 月起核發部分許可。
黃仁勳 3 月表示，輝達已接獲中國客戶訂單，並著手重啟生產。但輝達在財報中指出，受北京方面限制，實際出貨僅占美方核准數量的一小部分。
截至 7 月 26 日的一季，依許可出貨至中國的 H200 所帶來的營收，占輝達全球資料中心營收不到 1%。
按直接客戶總部所在地統計，輝達 2026 會計年度來自中國 (含香港) 的營收為 196.77 億美元，占總營收 9.1%。截至今年 7 月 26 日的一季則為 78.80 億美元，占 8.2%。這項區域營收涵蓋遊戲、車用等業務，客戶總部所在地也可能與晶片出貨地或終端使用地不同。
輝達對 2027 會計年度第三季開出的 1,080 億美元營收指引，已將中國資料中心運算營收按零估算。
因此，H200 許可若進一步收緊，首先影響的是輝達未來擴大對中出貨的空間。若國會或白宮進一步管制海外晶片流向與遠端算力，影響範圍則可能延伸到輝達的海外雲端客戶。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 連兩個交易日收黑，美東時間週一 (9 日) 收跌 4.27%，報 178.67 美元，市值縮水約 1,921 億美元。週二 (10 日) 再跌 5.53%，收在 168.80 美元，市值再減約 2,379 億美元。兩日股價累計下跌 9.56%，市值合計蒸發約 4,300 億美元，降至約 4.07 兆美元。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has long represented the company in lobbying Washington for relaxed AI chip export restrictions to China. Now Huang admits to an extramarital affair, and Nvidia's board has launched an independent investigation to determine whether he was ever targeted by foreign intelligence operations.

Patrick Moorhead, CEO of Moor Insights & Strategy, says the scandal has weakened Huang's influence on export policy, and future U.S. reviews of Nvidia's China‑export licenses may take this incident into account.

Bipartisan members of Congress are pushing to incorporate three chip‑control measures into the FY2027 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), which could pass as part of the defense bill as early as December.

Policy research firm Veda Partners raised the likelihood of the Chip Security Act becoming law from 60% to 80%. The scope of Washington's concern now extends beyond whether Nvidia can ship directly to China to include third‑country transshipment and whether Chinese firms can obtain advanced compute via overseas data centers.
Trump backs Huang; House three‑committee panel demands a closed‑door briefing

CNBC reports that Huang, during Trump’s second term, advised the White House on AI safety standards and actively lobbied to ease chip‑sale restrictions to China. Moorhead says in his 35‑year semiconductor career he has never seen a chip‑company CEO wield such direct influence over export policy.

Huang has been Nvidia’s primary spokesperson in dealings with Washington over its China business, and his ability to retain that influence will affect Nvidia’s prospects of re‑entering the Chinese AI‑chip market.

On Monday (the 9th), Trump told the White House that Huang said he was unaware of any intelligence‑gathering activities and that Trump believes him. Huang’s employee letter admitted infidelity without naming the other party and pledged full cooperation with the investigation.

Nvidia’s board said there is currently no reason to believe U.S. national security or company secrets have been compromised; independent directors and external legal counsel will review the relevant information.

Three Republican chairs of the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China committees have asked Huang to appear at a joint closed‑door briefing on November 18 to explain his contacts with former Megaspeed cloud‑computing executive Alice Huang and Nvidia’s anti‑espionage safeguards.
House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries also wants Congress to receive the full briefing and supports adding China‑chip‑sale restrictions to the final defense bill.
The three bills each target chip flow, export licensing, and manufacturing equipment

The three measures have been included in the Senate version of the defense bill, but not in the House version. Negotiations will focus on which provisions survive in the final bill and how broad the controls will be. Veda Partners analysts Henrietta Treyz and Dan McCarthy have raised the passage odds for all three.

The Chip Security Act would require certain advanced chips and related products to have location‑verification capabilities. If a holder detects that a product’s location or user does not match its export license, or that security mechanisms have been tampered with, they must report it to U.S. authorities. Passage odds rise from 60% to 80%.

The AI Overwatch Act would extend the ban on exporting top‑tier AI chips to China and other scrutinized nations. For advanced chips still eligible for a license, the Commerce Department must first certify to Congress that the export will not displace U.S. supply nor enable unauthorized remote use. Passage odds rise from 40% to 65%.

The MATCH Act would restrict sales of key semiconductor equipment to China and other targeted countries, bring repair and technical support under control, and push allies to adopt coordinated measures. Passage odds rise from 35% to 60%.

Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren and Republican Senator Jim Banks, co‑sponsors of the AI Overwatch Act, have urged its inclusion in the final bill. Owen Tedford, senior analyst at Beacon Policy Advisors, told MarketWatch that the Huang scandal and the White House’s willingness to propose revisions give the three bills more momentum in Congress. If the two chambers reach an agreement, he expects the final language to be softer than the original drafts and closer to the White House’s position.
Megaspeed’s involvement in physical chip flow and overseas compute rentals becomes another focus of scrutiny
The New York Times reported that U.S. intelligence believes Alice Huang is suspected of gathering information for Beijing. China’s foreign ministry denied the allegations.
U.S. investigators are also looking into whether Megaspeed routed controlled Nvidia chips to China.

Nvidia’s general counsel previously wrote to the Commerce Department asking about the investigation; the matter was later handed to the Justice Department. Megaspeed denies any wrongdoing, saying earlier checks found no evidence of violations.
Bloomberg’s trade‑record analysis found that Megaspeed imported about 50,000 more Nvidia chips than the inventory Nvidia initially recorded in its data centers.
Nvidia later said it found the hardware in other warehouses but did not disclose the exact quantity.
Moorhead noted that whether Blackwell chips ever passed through Megaspeed into China was a concern in Washington even before this scandal.

Washington is also examining another route. Chinese firms can rent server capacity from overseas providers while the physical chips remain abroad. CNBC previously reported that Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI had discussed renting a cluster of at least 8,000 Blackwell GPUs in Europe for inference workloads, though no deal has been confirmed. Veda analysts think the Trump administration is more likely in the short term to crack down on chip smuggling than to restrict Chinese firms’ remote use of overseas compute, and they see a low probability of revoking Nvidia’s H200 China export license soon.
H200 shipments to China remain limited; Q3 forecasts have already excluded revenue from Chinese data‑center compute
Since the U.S. tightened advanced‑chip export controls in 2022, Nvidia has repeatedly adjusted product specifications for the Chinese market.

In April 2025, the Trump administration added Nvidia’s H20, launched to meet the controls, to its export‑license requirements. Nvidia initially estimated up to $5.5 billion in inventory and procurement costs, ultimately recognizing $4.5 billion.
The Commerce Department switched to case‑by‑case reviews of H200 and similar chips’ China export applications in January and began issuing partial licenses in February.

In March, Huang said Nvidia had received orders from Chinese customers and was restarting production, but the company noted that, due to Beijing’s restrictions, actual shipments were only a small fraction of the approved volume.
For the quarter ending July 26, H200 shipments authorized for China accounted for less than 1% of Nvidia’s global data‑center revenue.

Based on the headquarters location of direct customers, Nvidia’s FY2026 revenue from China (including Hong Kong) was $19.677 billion, or 9.1% of total revenue; for the quarter ending July 26 it was $7.88 billion, or 8.2%. This regional figure includes gaming, automotive and other businesses, and the customer’s headquarters may not match the chip’s shipment or end‑use location.
Nvidia’s FY2027 Q3 revenue guidance of $108 billion assumes zero revenue from Chinese data‑center compute.

Thus, any further tightening of H200 licenses would first curb Nvidia’s ability to expand shipments to China. If Congress or the White House adds controls on overseas chip flow or remote compute, the impact could extend to Nvidia’s foreign cloud customers.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) fell black for two consecutive trading days. On Monday (the 9th) Eastern Time it dropped 4.27% to $178.67, wiping about $192.1 billion off its market cap. On Tuesday (the 10th) it fell another 5.53% to $168.80, shaving roughly $237.9 billion more. The two‑day decline totalled 9.56%, erasing about $430 billion in market value and leaving the company worth roughly $4.07 trillion.

items.title: CoreWeave股價自高點跌掉65%還沒脫困 財報亮眼也難解三大隱憂
items.title_en: CoreWeave Stock Down 65% From Peak Still Not Rescued; Strong Earnings Can't Allay Three Major Concerns
paras: AI新興雲端業者CoreWeave, Inc. Class A(CRWV-US) 第三季營收年增168%、上修全年財測，帶動周二（10日）盤後股價走高。但該股自半年前高點已重挫65%，亮眼財報仍難消除市場疑慮，資料中心建設受阻、科技巨頭支出收緊與債務壓力，持續籠罩成長前景。
營收大增168% 全年財測上修
根據公司聲明，CoreWeave第三季營收年增168%，但淨損也由去年同期的1.1億美元擴大至7.09億美元，相當於每股虧損1.27美元。季末未完成訂單達1,325億美元，這項衡量未來銷售情況的指標受到市場密切關注。
管理層將2026年全年營收預估上修至130億至133億美元，高於8月預估的124億至132億美元；調整後營業利益預估則由9.6億至11.5億美元，提高至12.75億至13.75億美元。
儘管營收成長與財測上修顯示AI基礎建設需求仍強，市場焦點已轉向成長能否持續。CoreWeave上周股價重挫15%，財報公布前的選擇權市場資料顯示，投資人預期財報後股價波動幅度約達16%。
選後建設阻力升高 新興雲端股承壓
美國期中選舉結果，成為衝擊市場情緒的直接導火線。多地選民表態反對在社區附近興建資料中心，使對AI基礎建設較為保守的民主黨籍州級與地方政府影響力上升，也讓投資人更關注管理層如何因應建設環境變化。
以德州為例，候任州長Gina Hinojosa已公開呼籲立即暫停資料中心專案審批。CoreWeave隨即致函，表達尋求合作的意願。
選後科技股走勢明顯分歧。微軟(MSFT-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 等大型雲端業者股價反彈，CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Nebius (YNDX-US) 及Iris (IREN-US) 等新興雲端業者則大幅下挫。
對大型雲端業者而言，AI資本支出放緩可能改善自由現金流；但對依賴AI高速成長支撐商業模式的新興業者來說，支出與建設減速，將直接衝擊核心業務。
50 Park Investments執行長Adam Sarhan表示，美國選民已透過選票表明，不希望資料中心建在住家附近。
新興雲端業者的處境因此更加艱難，因為它們缺乏其他收入來源，難以彌補AI業務可能出現的損失。
靠借貸擴張 部分債券殖利率突破15%
CoreWeave透過舉債興建資料中心，必須維持高速成長，才能支應債務成本。這種財務結構，使公司在建設與支出前景轉趨不明之際格外脆弱。
選舉結束後，CoreWeave債券價格隨即下跌，部分債券殖利率突破15%，進入市場通常視為困境債務的區間。
根據彭博彙整的分析師預估，CoreWeave在2029年以前仍將持續虧損，未來幾年的營收增速也將逐年放緩。第三季實際淨損大幅擴大，更凸顯營收快速成長之際，公司仍承受虧損壓力。
目前CoreWeave股價營收比約為1倍，接近歷史低點，僅約2025年3月上市以來平均水準的四分之一。然而，由於公司持續虧損，按多數估值指標衡量，股價仍顯昂貴。
Founder ETFs投資組合經理Michael Monaghan指出，AI支出前景的重要性遠超過財報本身，市場擔心的是，期中選舉是否意味AI基礎建設將進入減速週期。
財報難解疑慮 AI投資回報成關鍵
客戶的支出動向，也增添CoreWeave面臨的不確定性。微軟正加強部分專案的監督，並退出其認為風險過高的計畫。
CoreWeave的困境，也是本輪AI財報季市場情緒承壓的縮影。谷歌、Meta、亞馬遜與英特爾(INTC-US) 相繼遭遇財報後賣壓，微軟與SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 的強勁業績，同樣未能阻止股價下跌。
投資人對AI投資回報的質疑持續升高。在尚未看到更明確回報的情況下，市場對科技公司龐大AI資本支出的可持續性愈來愈審慎。
Sarhan表示，若AI收入枯竭，這些公司的合理價值幾乎肯定低於目前股價。除了AI之外，成長動能從何而來，以及若無法靠成長償還債務，如何維持償債能力，都是核心問題。
他也承認，新興雲端股短線技術面已出現超賣跡象，但在高度不確定性下，很難想像它們能重返過去的估值水準。
paras_en: AI‑focused cloud provider CoreWeave, Inc. Class A (CRWV‑US) reported third‑quarter revenue up 168% year‑over‑year and raised its full‑year outlook, sending the after‑hours price higher on Tuesday (the 10th). Yet the shares have fallen 65% from their six‑month high, and the impressive results have not erased market worries about data‑center construction delays, tighter spending by tech giants and debt pressure, all of which continue to cloud its growth outlook.
Revenue jumps 168% and full‑year outlook raised

According to the company’s statement, CoreWeave’s Q3 revenue grew 168% year‑over‑year, but net loss also widened from $110 million a year ago to $709 million, or a loss of $1.27 per share. Back‑log at quarter‑end stood at $132.5 billion, a metric that investors watch closely as an indicator of future sales.

Management lifted its 2026 full‑year revenue forecast to $13.0‑$13.3 billion, above the August range of $12.4‑$13.2 billion; adjusted operating profit guidance was also raised from $960 million‑$1.15 billion to $1.275‑$1.375 billion.

Although the revenue growth and upgraded outlook show that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong, the market’s focus has shifted to whether that growth can be sustained. CoreWeave’s stock fell 15% last week, and options data before the earnings release indicated investors expect post‑earnings price swings of roughly 16%.
Post‑election construction headwinds increase pressure on emerging cloud stocks

The U.S. midterm election results became a direct catalyst for market sentiment. Voters in many areas voiced opposition to building data centers near residential neighborhoods, boosting the influence of Democratic state‑ and local‑government officials who are more cautious about AI infrastructure and prompting investors to watch how management will respond to the changing construction environment.

In Texas, for example, gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa has publicly called for an immediate pause on data‑center project approvals. CoreWeave promptly sent a letter expressing its willingness to cooperate.

Post‑election tech‑stock performance diverged sharply. Shares of large cloud players such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) rebounded, while emerging cloud firms like CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Nebius (YNDX‑US) and Iris (IREN‑US) slumped sharply.

For the big cloud providers, a slowdown in AI capital spending could improve free cash flow; for emerging players that rely on rapid AI‑driven growth to sustain their business models, slower spending and construction directly hits their core operations.
50 Park Investments CEO Adam Sarhan said U.S. voters have signaled through the ballot that they do not want data centers built near homes.
The situation for emerging cloud firms therefore becomes tougher, because they lack other revenue streams to offset potential losses from their AI businesses.
Expansion funded by debt; some bond yields break 15%

CoreWeave finances data‑center builds through borrowing and must keep growth fast enough to cover debt costs. This capital structure makes the company especially vulnerable when construction and spending outlooks become uncertain.
After the election, CoreWeave bond prices fell sharply, with yields on some issues pushing past 15%, a level typically viewed as distressed debt territory.

Bloomberg‑aggregated analyst estimates suggest CoreWeave will remain loss‑making until at least 2029, with revenue growth slowing year over year in the coming years. The sharply larger Q3 net loss underscores that, despite rapid revenue expansion, the company is still under loss pressure.

CoreWeave’s price‑to‑revenue multiple is now about 1×, near a historic low and roughly a quarter of its average level since its March 2025 IPO. Yet because the firm continues to lose money, most valuation metrics still deem the stock expensive.

Founder ETFs portfolio manager Michael Monaghan noted that the importance of AI‑spending outlook far outweighs the earnings numbers themselves; the market worries whether the midterms signal the start of a slowdown in AI infrastructure investment.
Earnings can’t dispel concerns; AI investment returns become the key issue
Customer spending trends also add to CoreWeave’s uncertainty. Microsoft is tightening oversight on certain projects and pulling out of programs it deems too risky.

CoreWeave’s predicament mirrors the broader pressure on AI‑earnings season sentiment. Google, Meta, Amazon and Intel (INTC‑US) all faced selling pressure after their reports, and even strong results from Microsoft and SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) failed to stop their shares from falling.

Investor doubts about AI‑investment returns are rising. Without clearer evidence of payoff, the market is becoming increasingly cautious about the sustainability of massive AI capital outlays by tech firms.

Sarhan said that if AI revenue dries up, the fair value of these companies would almost certainly be below current stock prices. Beyond AI, the question is where growth will come from and, if growth can’t service debt, how they will maintain solvency.

He also acknowledged that emerging‑cloud stocks have shown short‑term technical oversold signals, but in an environment of high uncertainty it is hard to imagine they can regain their previous valuation levels.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美CPI火熱、Fed理事鷹派談話強化升息預期 美元攀高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: US CPI Hot, Fed Governor’s Hawkish Remarks Strengthen Rate‑Hike Expectations, Dollar Rises
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周二(10日)攀高，美國通膨數據比預期火熱，強化了聯準會(Fed)下月升息機率。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.57%，報102.26。
歐元兌美元下跌0.55%，報1.116美元。美元兌日元上漲0.55%，報158.80日元。元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.71%，報0.8252瑞郎。
美國勞工部公布的數據顯示，美國10月消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.4%，高於經濟學家預估的月增0.3%。
數據公布後，美元兌一籃子貨幣延續漲勢。通常與Fed利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率也大幅跳升，最新上漲18.44個基點至4.731%。
渣打銀行(Standard Chartered Bank) G10外匯研究及北美總體策略全球主管Steve Englander表示，市場對這份數據感到措手不及，因為數據似乎支持Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周二發表的鷹派談話。華勒當時表示，Fed應在下個月升息，以提高短期借貸成本。
Englander說：「華勒的談話如此鷹派，引起市場注意。美元和利率的這波漲勢就是從那時開始的。」
他表示：「CPI數據也偏熱，尤其是通膨似乎相當廣泛，因此市場開始感到擔憂。美國11月3日期中選舉以來，美元走勢大多受到油價交易主導，但現在市場人士開始認為：『我們是不是看錯了重點？真正應該關注的是通膨風險，以及Fed的政策動向。』」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場目前預估Fed 12月升息的機率接近91%。
對貿易情勢與市場情緒較為敏感的澳幣兌美元下跌0.89%，報0.686美元。紐元兌美元下跌0.56%，報0.56美元。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta說：「短期內美元走弱的空間仍然有限。勞動市場展現韌性，加上國內經濟活動穩健，持續支撐美國消費，也降低經濟突然放緩的風險，很難看到年底前持續走貶。」

paras_en: The dollar rose against major currencies on Tuesday (the 10th), as US inflation data came in hotter than expected, bolstering the probability of a Fed rate hike next month.
The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, climbed 0.57% to 102.26.
The euro fell 0.55% against the dollar to $1.116, the dollar rose 0.55% against the yen to ¥158.80, and the euro gained 0.71% against the Swiss franc to CHF 0.8252.
US Labor Department data showed that the US consumer price index (CPI) for October rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above economists’ forecast of a 0.3% increase.

After the release, the dollar continued its rally against a basket of currencies. The US 2‑year Treasury yield, which usually moves in line with Fed rate expectations, jumped sharply, up 18.44 basis points to 4.731%.

Steve Englander, Global Head of G10 FX Research and North America Macro Strategy at Standard Chartered Bank, said the market was caught off guard by the data because it seemed to support Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s hawkish comments on Tuesday. Waller said the Fed should raise rates next month to lift short‑term borrowing costs.
Englander said, “Waller’s remarks were so hawkish that they grabbed market attention. The dollar and rate rally started from that point.”

He added, “The CPI data was also on the hotter side, especially since inflation appears fairly broad‑based, so the market began to worry. Since the US mid‑term elections on November 3, the dollar’s moves have been largely driven by oil‑price trading, but now market participants are thinking: ‘Did we miss the point? The real focus should be on inflation risk and Fed policy direction.’”
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now estimates a roughly 91% chance of a Fed rate hike in December.
The Australian dollar, which is sensitive to trade conditions and market sentiment, fell 0.89% against the dollar to $0.686, while the New Zealand dollar slipped 0.56% to $0.56.

Karl Schamotta, Chief Market Strategist at Corpay, said, “The short‑term upside for a weaker dollar is still limited. A resilient labour market, together with solid domestic economic activity that continues to support US consumption, reduces the risk of a sudden slowdown, making it hard to see a sustained decline before year‑end.”

items.title: 日本央行會議紀錄顯露鷹派訊號 多位委員支持加快升息至中立利率
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Meeting Minutes Reveal Hawkish Signals, Several Governors Back Faster Rate Hikes to Neutral Level
paras: 日本央行於10月29至30日召開貨幣政策會議，決議將政策利率維持在1.25%的30年高位，但最新公布的「主要意見」摘要顯示，多名審議委員對早期升息展現積極態度。
在會議表決中，被視為鷹派的審議委員高田創提出將利率調升至1.5%左右的提案，雖遭多數否決，而在9月反對升息的淺田統一郎與佐藤綾野兩位委員，本次投票贊成維持現狀。
針對未來貨幣政策走向，日銀總裁植田和男在會後記者會上強調，包含12月會議在內，每次會議都會評估是否升息，並指出基調物價通膨率已達到2%的政策目標。
會議紀錄中，有委員主張「不應過度謹慎，應在可行時實施升息」，也有委員表示日本經濟已進入「需加快腳步將政策利率推升至中立利率」的新階段。
一名委員指出，由於先前的升息，寬鬆程度已逐步降低。他補充說，政策利率目前處於日本央行估計的中性利率區間(1.1%-2.5%)內，但應注意未來升息可能抑制經濟成長和潛在通膨的風險。此外，多名委員指出當前金融環境仍屬寬鬆，應在數個月內確認金融情勢後「悠然但迅速」地調整政策。
隨著核心物價穩定成長，金融市場與利率掉期交易預估，日銀於12月再次升息25個基點的機率已高達七至八成。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan held its monetary policy meeting on October 29‑30, deciding to keep the policy rate at a 30‑year high of 1.25%, but the newly released summary of the "Main Opinions" shows that several board members were proactive about earlier rate hikes.

In the vote, hawkish board member Takada Hajime proposed raising the rate to around 1.5%, a motion that was largely rejected, while the two members who opposed a hike in September, Shimada Kazuo and Sato Ayano, voted to maintain the status quo this time.

Regarding the future path of monetary policy, BOJ Governor Ueda Kazuo stressed at the post‑meeting press conference that each meeting, including the December session, will assess whether to raise rates, noting that core‑inflation has already hit the 2% target.

The minutes record that some members argued "we should not be overly cautious and should raise rates when feasible," while others said Japan’s economy has entered a new phase "that requires accelerating the push to lift the policy rate to a neutral level."

One member pointed out that, because of previous hikes, the degree of monetary easing has already been gradually reduced. He added that the policy rate now sits within the BOJ’s estimated neutral range of 1.1%‑2.5%, but warned that further hikes could curb growth and potential inflation. Several members also noted that the financial environment remains accommodative and that policy should be adjusted "calmly but swiftly" within a few months after confirming financial conditions.
With core prices showing stable growth, financial markets and interest‑rate swap traders estimate a 70‑80% chance that the BOJ will raise rates by another 25 basis points in December.

items.title: 日元明年走勢兩極化！彭博前季預測冠軍估貶170 最新冠軍看升147
items.title_en: Yen's Outlook Next Year Splits: Bloomberg's Prior Quarter Champion Forecasts a 170 Decline, New Champion Sees a 147 Rise
paras: 在歷經多次金融危機與劇烈的匯率波動後，深耕日元市場近30年的外匯專家奈爾·帕克（Neil Parker）再次拋出震撼彈。根據彭博最新的外匯預測排名，這位日元兌美元預測準確率居冠的策略師認為，隨著美日利差逐步收窄，日元明年有望強勁反彈至 147 兌 1 美元。
在看法高度分歧的市場中，帕克屬於最樂觀的陣營之一。他預期日元年底前將升至155日元兌1美元左右，之後進一步走強；上季度的彭博預測冠軍看法則截然相反，認為日元明年將一路走貶至 170 大關。
造成市場預測極端分歧的核心原因，在於對日本央行（BOJ）升息路徑的判斷差異。
帕克預估日本央行將把基準利率從 1.25% 一路調升至至少 2%，甚至上看 2.25%，其緊縮立場遠比市場主流預期更為激進；至於美國聯準會（Fed），他則預期 12 月可能再升息一次，最終將政策利率凍結在 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間。
至於美國聯準會（Fed），他則預期 12 月可能再升息一次，最終將政策利率凍結在 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間。
擔任外匯與支付公司TTT Moneycorp經濟暨市場策略主管的帕克表示：「日本可能成為少數例外，日本銀行確實會履行承諾，將利率調整至與通膨相符的水準。」
日本市場人士對於通膨升溫是否會促使央行加快緊縮，仍存在分歧。日本9月扣除生鮮食品與能源的消費者物價指數年增2.4%，這也是日本銀行密切關注、用來衡量底層通膨的指標。
帕克表示，若增幅升至2.6%或更高，可能促使央行採取更強力措施，加快緊縮步調。不過，他也不確定日本銀行是否會最快在12月就採取行動。
日美緊縮步調的差異，是他預測日元走強的基礎。他表示，兩國利差若再縮小約50個基點，也就是他預期明年年中至下半年可能出現的幅度，或許就足以促使投資人重新調整預期。
他說：「投資人不一定要加碼日本資產，只要降低減碼幅度就夠了。」
日元今年平均匯率約為158日元兌1美元，7月一度貶至163.99，隨後日本與美國當局出手干預。市場劇烈波動考驗著派克的預測，但除非支撐其判斷的經濟基本面改變，否則他不願輕易調整展望。
在建構預測模型時，帕克會將市場對利率與通漲的預期與自身研判進行對照，從中尋找價格錯置所產生的匯率波段機會。
他透露其獨門心法在於摒除過多市場噪音，僅專注於少數關鍵的總體經濟指標，而非過度解讀各國央行官員的發言或隨市場情緒起舞。
運用類似方法，派克也在彭博歐元兌日元預測排名中奪冠，不過他坦言，這項成績也受惠於長期對歐洲經濟抱持悲觀看法，以及一些運氣。
他表示：「從某些方面來說，歐元兌日元的預測比美元兌日元多了些運氣成分。」
他指出，歐洲大幅降息，加上經濟缺乏韌性，使他對歐元持悲觀看法。「至於美元兌日元，我認為更能依循總體經濟因素來判斷。」
帕克於1995年踏入金融市場，數十年來持續追蹤日元及其他主要貨幣。根據他的LinkedIn個人資料，他於2025年加入總部位於倫敦的TTT Moneycorp。這家外匯與支付公司也在彭博最新的歐元兌美元及美元兌瑞士法郎預測排名中居冠。
帕克表示，職涯早期的日元走勢與總體經濟關聯更密切，當時較容易預測。不過，他並不認為如今的日元特別難以預測，因為日本央行對數據的反應更加敏銳，尤其是通膨數據。
他最後強調，外匯預測的本質不在於憑空研判走勢的終點，而是精確捉摸自身觀點與市場大盤預期之間的相對落差。
paras_en: After weathering multiple financial crises and sharp exchange‑rate swings, Neil Parker, a foreign‑exchange specialist who has been deep‑rooted in the yen market for nearly 30 years, has again dropped a bombshell. According to Bloomberg's latest FX forecast rankings, the strategist with the highest accuracy in predicting USD/JPY believes that as the US‑Japan rate differential narrows, the yen could rebound strongly to 147 per dollar next year.

In a market where views are sharply divided, Parker is among the most optimistic camp. He expects the yen to climb to around 155 per dollar by year‑end and then strengthen further; Bloomberg’s previous quarter champion, by contrast, predicted the yen would slide all the way to the 170 level next year.
The core reason for the extreme split in market forecasts lies in differing judgments about the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) rate‑hiking path.

Parker projects the BOJ will raise its policy rate from 1.25% up to at least 2%, possibly as high as 2.25%, a tightening stance far more aggressive than mainstream market expectations; regarding the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed), he foresees a possible rate hike in December, ultimately freezing policy rates in the 4.00%‑4.25% range.
Regarding the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed), he foresees a possible rate hike in December, ultimately freezing policy rates in the 4.00%‑4.25% range.

Parker, who serves as Head of Economic and Market Strategy at foreign‑exchange and payments firm TTT Moneycorp, said, "Japan may be one of the few exceptions; the BOJ will indeed honor its commitment and adjust rates to a level consistent with inflation."

Market participants in Japan remain split on whether rising inflation will prompt the central bank to accelerate tightening. Japan’s core CPI (excluding fresh food and energy) rose 2.4% year‑over‑year in September, a key gauge the BOJ watches closely to assess underlying inflation.
Parker noted that if the increase reaches 2.6% or higher, it could push the BOJ to take stronger action and speed up tightening, though he is unsure whether the bank will act as early as December.

The divergence in tightening pace between the U.S. and Japan underpins his yen‑strength forecast. He says a further narrowing of the interest‑rate gap by about 50 basis points – the magnitude he expects around mid‑to‑late next year – could be enough to make investors revise their expectations.
He added, "Investors don’t necessarily need to increase exposure to Japanese assets; simply reducing the pace of de‑risking is sufficient."

The yen’s average rate this year has been about 158 per dollar, slipping to 163.99 in July before Japanese and U.S. authorities intervened. Market volatility tests Parker’s forecast, but unless the underlying economic fundamentals that support his view change, he is reluctant to alter his outlook.
When building his forecast model, Parker compares market expectations for rates and inflation with his own analysis, seeking price dislocations that create exchange‑rate swing opportunities.
He revealed his secret lies in filtering out excessive market noise and focusing on a handful of key macro indicators, rather than over‑interpreting central‑bank speeches or chasing market sentiment.
Using a similar approach, Parker also topped Bloomberg’s EUR/JPY forecast rankings, though he admits that result was helped by a long‑standing bearish view on Europe’s economy and a bit of luck.
He said, "In some respects, the EUR/JPY forecast involved more luck than the USD/JPY one."

He pointed out that Europe’s deep rate cuts and a lack of economic resilience have made him bearish on the euro. "As for USD/JPY, I think it can be judged more directly by macro fundamentals," he added.

Parker entered the financial markets in 1995 and has tracked the yen and other major currencies for decades. According to his LinkedIn profile, he joined London‑based TTT Moneycorp in 2025. The firm also leads Bloomberg’s latest forecast rankings for EUR/USD and USD/CHF.

Parker said his early‑career yen moves were more closely tied to macro fundamentals and therefore easier to predict. He does not think the yen is especially harder to forecast today, as the BOJ now reacts more sharply to data, especially inflation figures.

He concluded that the essence of FX forecasting is not to guess the ultimate direction out of thin air, but to precisely gauge the relative gap between one’s own view and the broader market consensus.

items.title: 高盛點名！AI股下跌首選避險貨幣標的：日元
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Names AI Stock Decline Hedge: Japanese Yen
paras: 高盛最新表示，儘管近期美股回檔時，日元避險屬性表現平淡，但若AI概念股進一步走低，日元仍是最佳貨幣避險工具。
由Kamakshya Trivedi領銜的策略師在報告中指出，市場無需過度外推近期美元兌日元與科技股的弱聯動關係，仍有多項理由支撐日圓避險價值。
數據顯示，自10月初以來，在那斯達克指數表現落後標普500的交易日內，美元兌日元平均走低，上周四(5日)股市暴跌當日也不例外。美元兌日元與AI相關股票日報酬率的一個月滾動相關性，已飆升至今年以來最高水準。
根據高盛策略師分析，上周四股市重挫、隔日反彈的走勢，反映出波動主因更可能是倉位調整，而非AI產業基本面預期惡化。
他們判斷，若全球經濟前景明顯轉差，匯市波動率將攀升，日元表現有望跑贏其他主要貨幣。做空美元兌日元作為對沖工具的效果將更顯著，但前提是，基本面預期必須出現比當前更大、更廣泛的轉變。
該投行也重申，投資人不應輕忽日元的防禦性配置價值，在AI敘事持續擾動市場的環境下，日元仍是對沖科技股回檔風險的首選貨幣。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs recently said that although the yen’s hedge property has been muted during the recent pullback in U.S. equities, if AI‑related stocks fall further the yen remains the best currency hedge tool.

Strategists led by Kamakshya Trivedi noted in the report that the market need not over‑extrapolate the recent weak correlation between the dollar‑yen pair and tech stocks, as there are still many reasons to support the yen’s hedge value.

Data show that since early October, on trading days when the Nasdaq lagged the S&P 500, the dollar‑yen pair tended to weaken, and last Thursday (the 5th) when the market crashed was no exception. The one‑month rolling correlation between the dollar‑yen and daily returns of AI‑related stocks has surged to its highest level this year.

According to Goldman strategists, last Thursday’s sharp market drop and the next‑day rebound suggest that the main driver of volatility was more likely position‑adjustment rather than a deterioration in AI industry fundamentals.

They judge that if the global economic outlook clearly worsens, FX volatility will rise and the yen is likely to outperform other major currencies. Shorting the dollar‑yen as a hedge will become more effective, provided that fundamental expectations shift larger and more broadly than they do today.

The bank also reiterated that investors should not overlook the defensive value of the yen; in an environment where the AI narrative continues to stir markets, the yen remains the top currency for hedging against tech‑stock pullbacks.

paras: 最新外匯策略報告顯示，即便AI投資熱潮引發資本市場震盪，美元基本面支撐並未動搖。對此巴克萊表示，美國經濟數據維持強勁，AI資本開支週期短期內大幅下修機率不高，因此繼續看好美元回檔後逢低買進的交易策略。
目前，美元風險溢價已回落至約1%，創一年多以來最低。機構分析指出，受歐元空頭部位擁擠影響，歐元兌美元或階段性反彈至1.14附近，但依托美國宏觀經濟的持續韌性，這一輪上行情難以持續。
巴克萊引用1858年巨型遠洋郵輪「大東方號」建造往事作為類比：該計畫投資耗資巨大、一波三折，最終推動跨洋海底電報電纜落地，也衍生出匯市術語「cable」。
報告認為，當下AI投資浪潮是上世紀網路熱潮之後，規模宏大、前景未知的重大技術投資週期，市場正重新定價風險與報酬。
市場擔憂AI資本開支潛藏多重隱患：算力需求是否存在虛高、產業鏈交叉融資會否形成連鎖風險、資料中心建設面臨的地方政治阻力等。
但巴克萊判斷指出，存量資料中心建設項目將穩步落地，超大規模雲廠商並未放緩投資借貸計劃，預計2027年底進入正向現金流階段，算力擴容也帶動企業真實需求增長，AI技術浪潮已經成型，難以逆轉。
按幣種來看，歐元對沖美元的吸引力持續走弱。法國財政壓力疊加選舉帶來的政治不確定性，推升法國公債利差；歐洲央行終端利率預期回落至3%附近，進一步升息空間受限，歐元中期前景偏空，僅存技術性反彈機會。
日元則持續受益避險資金流入。測算顯示美股回檔幅度若擴大，美元兌日元可望向155區間靠攏，但投機部位轉為日元淨多頭，將會約束日元升值節奏。
亞洲貨幣走勢明顯分化：科技股波動拖累韓元，外資持續流出帶來上行壓力；印度盧比則因油價走低、本土AI部位有限支撐；馬來西亞林吉特則同時承受油價下跌與資料中心投資預期降溫的雙重壓力。
巴克萊總結指出，目前AI股票拋售尚未對美元形成實質衝擊，美國經濟增速高於潛在水準、通膨黏性猶存，資本開支週期短期不會出現斷崖式收縮，美元依舊具備配置價值。
paras_en: The latest foreign exchange strategy report shows that even though the AI investment boom has shaken capital markets, the fundamentals supporting the dollar remain unchanged. Barclays notes that U.S. economic data stay strong and the probability of a sharp short‑term cut in AI capital spending is low, so it continues to favor a strategy of buying the dollar on pullbacks after a rally.

Currently, the dollar risk premium has fallen to about 1%, its lowest level in over a year. The firm’s analysis points out that a crowded short position in the euro has pushed the euro‑to‑dollar rate to rebound around 1.14, but the ongoing resilience of the U.S. macroeconomy makes this upward move unlikely to sustain.

Barclays uses the 1858 construction of the massive ocean liner "Great Eastern" as an analogy: the project was hugely costly and fraught with setbacks, ultimately enabling the deployment of trans‑Atlantic telegraph cables and giving rise to the currency‑market term "cable."

The report argues that the current AI investment wave is the largest, most uncertain major technology investment cycle since the internet boom of the last century, and that markets are re‑pricing risk and reward.

Market concerns about AI capital spending include whether computing power demand is overestimated, whether cross‑industry financing could create chain risks, and the political resistance faced by data‑center construction.

However, Barclays believes that existing data‑center projects will steadily materialise, large cloud providers are not slowing their investment‑and‑borrowing plans, and by the end of 2027 they will enter a positive cash‑flow phase. Computing capacity expansion will also drive real corporate demand, and the AI technology wave is already taking shape and unlikely to reverse.

In terms of currencies, the euro’s appeal as a hedge against the dollar continues to weaken. French fiscal pressure combined with election‑related political uncertainty pushes French bond spreads higher; expectations that the European Central Bank’s terminal rate will fall to around 3% further limit room for rate hikes, making the euro’s medium‑term outlook bearish with only a technical rebound possibility.

The yen continues to benefit from safe‑haven flows. Calculations suggest that if the U.S. equity pullback widens, the dollar‑to‑yen rate could converge toward the 155 area, but speculative positions turning net long on the yen will constrain its appreciation pace.

Asian currencies show clear divergence: volatility in tech stocks drags the Korean won, continued outflows of foreign capital exert upward pressure; the Indian rupee suffers from falling oil prices and limited domestic AI support; the Malaysian ringgit faces dual pressure from lower oil prices and a cooling expectation of data‑center investment.

Barclays concludes that the current sell‑off in AI stocks has not materially impacted the dollar. U.S. growth remains above potential, inflationary stickiness persists, and the capital‑spending cycle is unlikely to experience a cliff‑like contraction in the short term, leaving the dollar still attractive for allocation.

paras: 美國期中選舉結果揭曉，民主黨一舉奪下參、眾兩院多數席次。這不僅使美國總統川普未來兩年的政策推動面臨國會制衡，也瞬間掀起全球金融市場的波瀾。美元指數應聲下跌，觸及近一個月低點，歐元、日圓等主要貨幣全面走強。隨著政治版圖重洗牌，市場焦點迅速從選舉結果轉向政策走向、聯準會利率及經濟前景，美元後市如何發展，正牽動全球投資人的神經。
期中選舉改變政治版圖　美元走勢面臨新考驗
2026年美國期中選舉於11月3日落幕，民主黨不僅奪回眾議院控制權，也在參議院取得多數席次，打破共和黨原先掌握的國會優勢。隨著新一屆國會預計於2027年1月3日上任，美國將形成民主黨掌控國會、共和黨掌握白宮的分立政府局面。市場開始評估，美國總統川普未來推動財政、貿易及產業政策，可能面臨更大的國會制衡，進而影響美國經濟與金融市場走向。

根據路透社11月4日報導，民主黨在期中選舉取得重大勝利後，美元指數盤中下跌0.6%，一度觸及101.27的近一個月低點；歐元兌美元上漲0.6%，升至1.1258美元，日圓也升值近0.8%，來到1美元兌157.92日圓，瑞士法郎同步走強。與此同時，美國10年期公債殖利率下滑近5個基點至4.915%。市場預期，在國會制衡下，川普政府的財政刺激力道可能縮減，AI相關支出也可能放緩，進而下修對2027年升息的預期。
由於美國近年經濟成長受到AI相關投資支撐，民主黨取得國會多數後，市場也關注未來針對科技企業及AI產業的監管方向。不過，在分立政府格局下，大規模新法案較難通過，相關監管短期內出現重大轉變的可能性有限。後續市場仍將觀察AI投資動能能否延續，以及對美國經濟成長的支撐力道。
此外，國會版圖改變也不代表川普政府的政策將全面轉向。美國總統仍握有法案否決權，部分行政權限及貿易政策也不完全受國會立法進度限制。因此，選舉結果雖然為美元帶來短期壓力，但後續走勢仍取決於經濟基本面、貨幣政策及國際市場變化。

事實上，美元走勢受到多重因素影響。除了美國政治局勢，聯準會（Fed）貨幣政策、美國經濟數據及國際資金流向，同樣扮演重要角色。首先是美國政府政策方向：隨著國會權力結構改變，川普政府未來在財政、稅收及經貿政策上的推動空間可能受到限制。若府會政策協商陷入僵局，政策短期內較難出現重大轉變，反而可能降低市場面臨的政策不確定性。

Midterm election reshapes the political map, presenting new tests for the dollar’s movement.

The 2026 U.S. midterm election concluded on November 3, with the Democratic Party not only regaining control of the House but also securing a majority in the Senate, breaking the Republican Party’s prior congressional advantage. With the new Congress expected to convene on January 3, 2027, the U.S. will have a divided government: Democrats controlling Congress and Republicans holding the White House. Markets are evaluating how President Trump’s fiscal, trade, and industrial policies may face greater congressional checks, potentially influencing the U.S. economy and financial markets.

According to Reuters on November 4, after the Democrats’ decisive midterm victory, the dollar index fell 0.6% intraday, briefly touching a near one‑month low of 101.27; the euro rose 0.6% against the dollar to 1.1258, the yen also appreciated nearly 0.8% to 157.92 yen per dollar, and the Swiss franc strengthened. Meanwhile, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield fell almost 5 basis points to 4.915%. Markets expect that under congressional checks, the Trump administration’s fiscal stimulus may be reduced, AI‑related spending may slow, and expectations for a 2027 rate hike may be cut.

Because recent U.S. economic growth has been supported by AI‑related investment, the Democratic majority in Congress has prompted market attention to future regulatory directions for tech companies and the AI industry. However, under a divided government, large new legislation is harder to pass, limiting the likelihood of major regulatory shifts in the short term. Markets will continue to watch whether AI investment momentum persists and its support for U.S. economic growth.

Moreover, the congressional shift does not mean the Trump administration’s policies will fully reverse. The president still holds veto power, and some executive authority and trade policy are not entirely constrained by congressional legislative progress. Thus, while the election results exert short‑term pressure on the dollar, its subsequent trajectory still depends on economic fundamentals, monetary policy, and international market changes.
How will the dollar move in the future? Three key indicators to watch.

In fact, the dollar’s movement is influenced by multiple factors. Beyond U.S. political conditions, Fed monetary policy, U.S. economic data, and international capital flows also play important roles. First is U.S. government policy direction: with the congressional power structure changed, the Trump administration’s space to push fiscal, tax, and trade policy may be limited. If policy negotiations stall, significant changes are unlikely in the short term, potentially reducing market policy uncertainty.

Second is Fed monetary policy: the dollar and U.S. interest rates have always been closely linked. If markets expect rates to stay high, it helps support the dollar’s asset appeal; conversely, if economic growth slows and rate‑cut expectations rise, the dollar may face pressure. Therefore, future inflation and employment data remain key indicators.

Third is geopolitical and safe‑haven capital flows: as the world’s main trading and reserve currency, the dollar attracts funds when international conflicts flare, energy prices swing sharply, or risk appetite declines, providing support for the dollar.

In other words, while the midterm election changes the U.S. political map and temporarily affects the dollar, a divided government also means a lower likelihood of drastic policy shifts. Future exchange rates still depend on the interaction of multiple factors; markets must monitor the Trump administration’s interaction with Congress, U.S. Treasury yields, Fed decisions, and monetary policy changes in major economies like the eurozone and Japan to fully grasp global currency market trends.
